decisions: The owner asked for ticket #126 to be implemented: the factory tick must log a hooks-checked event recording that both hooks (guard-target.ts and factory-policy.ts) passed their self-test. Owner-chosen scope, from the ticket's Done when list.

Agent decision: the event is logged right after the workspace is built (log event 'workspace') and before 'agent-started', not before 'picked' as the ticket literally says. Reason: the self-test runs inside deps.workspace(runId) against the run's own worktree copy of .claude/hooks, which exists only after the ticket is picked and claimed. Moving it earlier would mean running the self-test against a different checkout than the one the agent gets. Flagged for the owner in the PR.
Agent decision: hookSelfTest keeps its old signature and return value (a list of problem strings) and now wraps a new hookSelfTestReport, so existing callers and tests are unchanged.

Agent decision: a failed settings check or self-test throws a HooksCheckError carrying the report, so the tick's existing catch block can log hooks-checked with the problems before the existing 'error' event. The exit behaviour (the run stops, the ticket goes to agent-needs-help) is unchanged because the same error is thrown with the same message.

Agent decision on the first local review (finding 9fd82c03, ordering): declined as intentional. hooks-checked cannot literally precede picked, because the self-test runs against the worktree built after the ticket is picked and claimed; a pre-pick check would test the runner checkout, not the agent one. The ticket wording will be amended by the owner; the PR says so.
notes:
Task requirements (ticket #126, Done when): (1) the tick logs one hooks-checked event before picked, with each hook's name, the three self-test outcomes (deny, allow, not-JSON) and the slowest answer in ms; (2) a failed settings check or self-test logs the same event with the problems, before the tick exits with its existing code; (3) the event is in the public run artifact and the evidence saved to the private repo, because it is part of the run's .jsonl log; (4) docs/factory-trigger.md names the event where it describes the self-test; (5) a test per bullet with a fake hook runner. Must not break: the exit codes of factory:tick for a failed settings check or self-test; the 15-second hook limit and the half-limit budget the self-test uses. Out of scope: changing what the self-test checks.
Code: packages/harness/src/factory-tick.ts. New exports: HookReport, HooksReport, hookSelfTestReport, HooksCheckError, hooksEvent. requireHooks (inside realDeps) now returns a HooksReport or throws HooksCheckError; both realDeps.workspace implementations (local worktree, and the CI one) put it on Workspace.hooks (optional field, so test fakes need not set it). tick() logs hooks-checked after 'workspace' when ws.hooks is set, and in the catch block when the error is a HooksCheckError. The log() function redacts secrets from every logged value before it is printed or recorded.
Verification run: npm run check passes (typecheck, Biome lint, 848 tests including 6 new ones in factory-tick.test.ts under 'hooks-checked: the run log records the hook self-test (#126)'). The new tests cover: per-hook outcomes and slowest answer, a failing hook still reported, the event's ok/slowestMs/problems fields, the tick logging it right after 'workspace' and before 'agent-started', no event when the workspace has no report, and a HooksCheckError logging the event before 'error' while the run still ends needs-help with the ticket relabelled. Not tested: a real factory run in CI; whether the public run artifact actually contains the event (it is part of the .jsonl log, which is published whole). The local workspace builder no longer loses the report when cleanup also fails: withCleanupFailure (new, exported, unit-tested) rethrows a HooksCheckError as a HooksCheckError with its report.
Self-test internals are unchanged: the same six payloads, the same deny/allow/not-JSON checks, the same half-of-limit time budget.
recent_work: Added HookReport/HooksReport types and hookSelfTestReport, keeping hookSelfTest as a wrapper that returns problems only.
Added HooksCheckError and hooksEvent; requireHooks now returns the report or throws HooksCheckError with it.
Workspace gained an optional hooks report; both workspace builders set it.
tick() logs hooks-checked after the workspace is built, and in the catch block for a HooksCheckError.
Added six tests and one sentence in docs/factory-trigger.md.

After the first local review: added withCleanupFailure so a HooksCheckError keeps its report when cleanup also fails (finding 09f12a3c), with three tests written before the fix. Declined the ordering finding with the reasoning above.
